Title: Cheese Pancakes
Ingredients:
1. 1 cup 5% fat white cheese
2. 2 יחידות eggs
3. ½ cups flour
4. 2 tablespoons date syrup
5. 1 cup whipping cream
6. 4 יחידות petit beurre biscuits
Steps:
1. Mix the white cheese with the eggs and flour to form a thick batter.
2. Fry spoonfuls of the batter in a greased pan until golden on both sides.
3. Whip the whipping cream until it forms whipped cream.
4. Serve with the whipped cream, crumbled biscuits, and date syrup.
